lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Independent application: guardian review and attestation of real-world evidence

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic guardian review and attestation of real-world evidence task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: The learner presents their assembled portfolio index, plan statement, support-needs statement, and contingency branch to a guardian, who reviews it against a completeness checklist and attests that the review happened — explicitly not judging whether the learner's chosen direction is the 'right' one.
safetyNotes: The guardian review checks completeness and honesty against the checklist — it does not evaluate or approve the learner's chosen life direction, which remains the learner's own.
Any remaining gap named honestly during this review is a valid outcome, not a failure of the review.

simulationAlternative.description: If no guardian or trusted adult is available for a live review session today, the learner completes the same checklist as a structured self-review, flags any section they are unsure about, and schedules the guardian review for as soon as one is available; this self-review carries equal credit for completing today's lesson.

materials: learner-local: the learner's assembled portfolio pieces from this unit

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: How did it feel to have someone else check your plan for completeness, separate from whether they agreed with your direction?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Review completeness: All four pieces were reviewed against the completeness checklist. | Honest reconciliation: Any remaining gap is named honestly, consistent with earlier work. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner write one sentence describing what they would want a reviewer to ask them at the final capstone defense, based on what came up in this review.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic guardian review and attestation of real-world evidence task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: 10–20 minutes for permission, required supervision or review, and physical-event attestation

localMaterials.label: the learner's assembled portfolio pieces from this unit
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: guardian review and attestation of real-world evidence worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner presents their assembled portfolio index, plan statement, support-needs statement, and contingency branch to a guardian, who reviews it against a completeness checklist and attests that the review happened — explicitly not judging whether the learner's chosen direction is the 'right' one.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact guardian review and attestation of real-world evidence decision or action.
Model move 2: Before the review, predict which piece your guardian will have the most questions about.
Model move 3: Present the portfolio pieces for review and record the outcome.
Model check: Review completeness: All four pieces were reviewed against the completeness checklist. | Honest reconciliation: Any remaining gap is named honestly, consistent with earlier work.

resources.title: guardian review and attestation of real-world evidence action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for guardian review and attestation of real-world evidence.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: guardian review and attestation of real-world evidence coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner presents their assembled portfolio index, plan statement, support-needs statement, and contingency branch to a guardian, who reviews it against a completeness checklist and attests that the review happened — explicitly not judging whether the learner's chosen direction is the 'right' one.
Coach direction: Before the review, predict which piece your guardian will have the most questions about.
Learner prompt: Which of your four assembled pieces do you predict your guardian (or the self-review checklist) will flag the most questions about, and why?
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: guardian review and attestation of real-world evidence complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Present the portfolio pieces for review and record the outcome.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I presented the portfolio index, plan statement, support-needs statement, and contingency branch for review.
Response 2 (t2-p2): The review (guardian or self-review) checked each piece against the completeness checklist.

Equal-access rule: If no guardian or trusted adult is available for a live review session today, the learner completes the same checklist as a structured self-review, flags any section they are unsure about, and schedules the guardian review for as soon as one is available; this self-review carries equal credit for completing today's lesson.

resources.title: guardian review and attestation of real-world evidence minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: How did it feel to have someone else check your plan for completeness, separate from whether they agreed with your direction?
Success checks: Review completeness: All four pieces were reviewed against the completeness checklist. | Honest reconciliation: Any remaining gap is named honestly, consistent with earlier work.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: guardian review and attestation of real-world evidence supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional guardian review and attestation of real-world evidence condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Review completeness: All four pieces were reviewed against the completeness checklist. | Honest reconciliation: Any remaining gap is named honestly, consistent with earlier work..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g12-u06-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Review completeness: All four pieces were reviewed against the completeness checklist. | Honest reconciliation: Any remaining gap is named honestly, consistent with earlier work.

guardianInvolvement.role: Give permission; provide only the supervision, handling, review, or observation named in the lesson; attest only that the physical event occurred.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
